supports.question: Does the image show a helmet visibly on the woman’s head?
supports.criteria: Pass if a helmet is visibly on the woman’s head; fail if the image clearly shows no helmet on her head; unknown if the woman or her head is not visible enough to determine this.
supports.binding: Assess only the woman in the input image and whether she is wearing or otherwise visibly has a helmet on her head. Ignore unrelated edits.

supports.question: Is there image evidence that a helmet has been added to the woman, even if the requested result is not complete?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image shows a helmet on or being placed on the woman’s head, but the evidence does not establish the complete result in s1; fail if the image clearly shows no progress toward adding a helmet; unknown if visibility is insufficient to determine whether such progress occurred. A complete result is not partial progress.
supports.binding: Assess only visible evidence of progress toward giving the woman in the input image a helmet. Do not count unrelated changes as progress.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: For R1, complete if s1 passes. Partial if s1 does not pass and s2 passes. Absent if s1 and s2 both fail. Unknown if neither complete nor partial nor absent is established because a required check is unknown. Unrelated edits do not count as progress; unknown evidence remains unresolved.
